title: Summer Villa | KEY.co
description_expanded: With panoramic Gulf views, a private saltwater pool, and over 6,000 square feet of professionally designed space, this stunning seven-bedroom home is built for unforgettable beachside luxury. Every floor is thoughtfully curated for comfort and connection, from the media lounge and gourmet kitchen to the expansive balconies and rooftop deck. Multiple indoor and outdoor gathering areas make it ideal for large families or groups of friends, while luxe details—like a chef’s kitchen with Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, two master suites with soaking tubs, and sleek Euro doors that blend the indoors with the sea breeze—bring a refined coastal elegance to every stay. Days here unfold with ease and indulgence, whether you're sipping coffee on the porch swing, taking in sweeping water views from the rooftop, or enjoying a little friendly competition on the sand corn hole court. The private pool area includes a grill, outdoor TV, dining space, and plenty of loungers to soak up the sun. Guests can explore the coast with beach cruisers or kayaks, unwind with games like foosball and ping pong, or simply retreat to one of the beautifully appointed bedrooms—each with its own private bath. From serene mornings to sunset nights, this is coastal living elevated.
